summary: Frontend-only verification of the shaky/blurry page bug fix (film-grain overlay). Confirmed: exactly ONE '.grain' element in DOM (App root), '.grain::before' has animation-name='none' (no keyframe animation running), position:fixed with inset:0, opacity:0.03, z-index:60. Zero running 'grain' animations found via document.getAnimations(). Hero renders crisply with headline 'Where the light still runs wild.' and horses image loaded. Regressions all green: navbar links present (nav-western/travel/prints/journal/about/contact) and smooth-scroll works; Western lightbox opens (western-item-0), next/prev/close all functional; Prints 'Inquire to purchase' (print-inquire-0) scrolls to contact, prefills subject 'Print inquiry — Rider at Dusk' and activates inquiry_type=print (bg-clay). Contact form submit succeeds with success toast 'Thank you — your message is on its way to Bill.', form clears, and inquiry is persisted via GET /api/inquiries (verified by unique TEST email). No 'Made with Emergent' badge or text anywhere in DOM.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix is clean and correct: .grain::before is now a single static fixed overlay applied once at the App root; the animated `.grain` classes on TravelGallery.jsx and Contact.jsx have been removed. This eliminates the compounding transform-animated overlays that were causing the whole-page shake.
Minor: hero h1 has no data-testid ('hero-headline') — cosmetic for tests only; not required by this bug fix. Text-based selection works.

Optional hardening: the SVG grain background image is inlined and 300x300; opacity 0.03 already makes it near-invisible. Consider removing it entirely if not visually needed to save ~1KB and one paint layer.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed inquiry (email TEST_grain_<uuid>@example.com) created via contact form during persistence verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Grain overlay bug is FIXED. Verify via: document.querySelectorAll('.grain').length === 1 and getComputedStyle(el,'::before').animationName === 'none'. Reusable pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_inquiries.py (~2s, 8 tests). Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll (window.__lenis).
rca of the issue: Root cause: an animated CSS film-grain overlay (.grain::before) using a huge fixed pseudo-element (inset:-200%) with a transform-based @keyframes 'grain' animation running every 0.6s was applied THREE times (App root + TravelGallery + Contact section). The stacked transform-animated overlays repainted large portions of the viewport 60fps, causing the whole-page 'shaky/vibrating' perception and softness. Fix in /app/frontend/src/index.css replaces .grain::before with a single static fixed layer (inset:0, no animation, opacity 0.03); the 'grain' className was removed from TravelGallery.jsx and Contact.jsx so it only lives once on the App root. Verified: 1 .grain element, animation-name='none', 0 running 'grain' animations.
